conventions.frame: ICRS/J2000, sourceward n, input z_CMB fixed
conventions.covariance: C_m(lambda)=N_m+lambda*S_m; lambda multiplies variance, not standard deviation
conventions.physical_map: dH=-A/(cH)+d_cal; kappa=sigma/H+q_cal; V=c*beta_MR under the inherited CONST_V response
conventions.calibration_metric: rho^2=|d_cal|^2/3+2||q_cal||_F^2/15 = full-sky mean square angular log-distance bias
conventions.angular8_test: dH=kappa=0 with V profiled; fixed-C chi-square_8
conventions.calibration_test: confidence-ellipsoid intersection, not a chi-square law for optimized distance
conventions.calibration_guarantee: if one included model, supplied covariance and stated deterministic budget are valid; post-hoc selection remains uncalibrated

five_views.x: joint signed alpha and full covariance; physical pullback with calibration coordinates
five_views.Q: minimum sky-RMS calibration gauge over the simultaneous confidence ellipsoid
five_views.Pi: fixed-lambda, explicitly targeted chi-square tails and finite-model maximum
five_views.F_support: support of the confidence ellipsoid plus deterministic calibration body
five_views.F_occupancy: UNAVAILABLE: no specified physical occupancy measure/ceiling
five_views.G_F: cross-window residual contrasts; full transformed covariance; residual-contrast amplitude likelihood

limitations: Conditional reanalysis of the existing selected CF4 experiment; no new catalogue or end-to-end survey mocks.
The seven nuisance operators are correlated transforms of the same data; no model-odds comparison or probability multiplication.
Cosmic-amplitude fits are not measurements of cosmological growth: they can absorb misspecification and unmodelled covariance.
No p-value is obtained by substituting a fitted amplitude into the known-covariance chi-square law.
Finite covariance-grid roots describe tested sensitivity, not a universal monotonicity theorem.
The full-sky RMS calibration body is a declared deterministic sensitivity family, not measured survey calibration.
Pointwise shear, acceleration and arbitrary tilt remain unbounded when their calibration or transfer is left unrestricted; omega has no distance column.
Neither scalar nor tensor morphology identifies a Bianchi Lie algebra without additional geometry and transfer information.
